summary: Approved. Read MANIFEST.json and all 24 packet files in full without executing any commands or following external paths. Verified models/utxo/qa/check.py, models/utxo/qa/test_check.py (62 unit tests), scripts/doctorwatson-utxo.sh, models/utxo/qa/README.md, openspec/changes/utxo-doctorwatson/requirements.md, openspec/changes/utxo-doctorwatson/evidence.schema.json, docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-17-doctorwatson-utxo.md, docs/utxo/doctorwatson/test-first-observation.json, captured bootstrap evidence, and full structural consistency of docs/utxo/doctorwatson/EARS-BASELINE.json and openspec/changes/utxo-doctorwatson/current-evidence.json against all 10 normative spec files (148 requirements, 292 scenarios, 20 families). The reader enforces safe repo-confined non-blocking file reads, strict JSON parsing (rejecting duplicate keys and NaN/Infinity), exact requirement/scenario/family/SHA-256 verification, all-open integrity vs failing --gate exit codes, profile/target non-migration and independent review checks for closed gates, transitive dependency staleness and open prerequisite gate propagation, complete readable per-requirement output, ready-before-blocked nextActions ordering with blockers retained, inert command string handling, and a standalone UTXO shell entrypoint that leaves Sherlock untouched.
limitations: Read-only packet review: no command, test, compiler, SDK, proof, wallet, or network operation was executed.
Ordinary local metadata reader review only, not a cryptographic or security assessment.

Baseline and canonical evidence files were verified for full structural consistency and byte/digest correspondence against the 10 normative spec files; canonical rows remain an initial all-open inventory and do not establish semantic product acceptance, compiler/proof/ledger correspondence, or review authenticity.
